## 1. Verdict
Deterministic mutation of canonical/out2.srt: byte at offset 120 (a '0' in cue 3's END
timestamp "00:01:02,050", 0x30) XOR 0x80 -> 0xb0 — verified byte-exact by python3
(`flip2_120 == base[:120] + bytes([base[120]^0x80]) + base[121:]` -> True). Name decodes
as flip = XOR 0x80, parent out2, offset 120. Effect is twofold: the file is invalid UTF-8
(Windows-1252 fallback -> "00:01:°2,050") AND the corrupted timestamp must degrade to a
typed damage event / skipped cue rather than a parse abort — the most adversarial of the
four fuzz fixtures assigned to me (mutation inside the timing grammar, not the payload).
Consumed by the corpus read_dir test (srt_fuzz_survival.rs:56-70). Nothing wrong with the
fixture.
